items.title: John Bunch interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: George Johnson was his name... he taught kids how to play the piano... I turned out to be one of his prized students

ctx.x: I wanted to ask, when did you first start playing piano and what led you to that?

Well I had a different sort of beginning from a lot of people in this business. I’m from a small town in Indiana, you know, a very small town, and all of a sudden along about when I was about eleven years old, a guy moved in to town. He was a barber, and he taught kids how to play the piano in ten easy lessons. Learn how to play the piano in ten easy lessons. And the kids loved this guy. George Johnson was his name, and he was just great with children. And I turned out to be one of his prized students, you know?…
